worlds.label: Paper cutout and collage
worlds.look: Layered cut paper, torn edges, tactile card and visible paper fibres, with real cast shadows between the layers. A handmade collage with a clearly distinct silhouette.

worlds.label: Skeleton and X-ray
worlds.look: An unmistakable stylised skeleton or translucent X-ray silhouette used as a visual metaphor. Non-graphic, no injury and no invented medical diagnosis, clinical result or evidence of efficacy.

worlds.label: Problem, lit like a thriller
worlds.look: Dark and moody. The problem is the subject, lit like a scene from a thriller: 1 hard light, deep shadow.

worlds.label: Studio comparison
worlds.look: A seamless studio background. The unbranded alternative is desaturated and plain on 1 side; this product is saturated and sharp on the other.

worlds.label: Dark macro luxury
worlds.look: Dark editorial product photography, very close, with 1 or 2 tiny specification callouts.

worlds.label: Epic monument
worlds.look: The product as a legend: huge, on a mountain, in forge light or under a storm sky.

worlds.label: Black and white with 1 accent
worlds.look: Monochrome photography of effort or motion, with 1 thing in the brand's colour.

worlds.label: Lifestyle with small flags
worlds.look: A warm, real-looking moment of life with the product in it, and at most 2 small chips carrying facts, inside the ad's ceiling of words.

worlds.label: Absurd, but photographed
worlds.look: Something that cannot be true, shot as if it were: 1 impossible thing in an ordinary place, played straight.

worlds.label: Soft clay and pastel 3D
worlds.look: Rounded matte clay shapes in pastel colours: a chart, a sequence or a small landscape made of clay.

worlds.label: 3D character scene
worlds.look: Stylised 3D people with big, readable expressions, caught in 1 moment of the problem.

worlds.label: The body part as a character
worlds.look: The part of the body the problem lives in, as a character with a face and a mood. The mechanism becomes someone.

worlds.label: Product mascot world
worlds.look: A character made from the product lives a small adventure. The same character can return in every ad of the set.

worlds.label: Miniature diorama
worlds.look: Tiny workers or people at work on a giant product or a giant version of the problem, like a model railway.

worlds.label: Dreamy pastel
worlds.look: Iridescent light, soft pastel air. The product pours or floats into a calm scene.

worlds.label: Storybook surreal
worlds.look: A paper-and-card world from a picture book: a boat on a sea made of something else, a path that is a game board.

worlds.label: Vintage comic or retro print
worlds.look: A panel from a mid-century comic or a retro poster: halftone dots, flat inks, 1 speech bubble.

worlds.label: Flat cartoon
worlds.look: A flat, friendly children's-book drawing of the problem at home.

worlds.label: Hand sketch
worlds.look: Ballpoint or marker on paper or a whiteboard: a diagram, a checklist or a scribble a person made to explain it.

worlds.label: Antique engraving
worlds.look: A labelled diagram in the style of an old medical or botanical plate, on cream paper.

worlds.label: Retro game screen
worlds.look: A pixel-art game screen of the app's own invention: health bars, a maze, a versus screen. No real game is copied.

worlds.label: Scientific imaging
worlds.look: A thermal image, an X-ray or a cutaway that shows what the eye can't see.

worlds.label: Annotated infographic
worlds.look: The whole ad is 1 process diagram or timeline, with labels and arrows.

worlds.label: A message between 2 people
worlds.look: A plain chat between 2 people on a phone, in a generic design of the app's own. No real platform's interface is copied.

worlds.label: A photo of a billboard
worlds.look: The ad as a billboard on a city street, photographed from the pavement by a passer-by.
